claims.population: The Yenagoa local government area has an area of 706 km2 and an estimated population of 798,466 at 2024.
claims.climate: The wetter season runs from March 20 to November 11 and the dry season from November 11 to March 20; Yenagoa lies in an area of swamps and mangrove tropical rainforest.
claims.people: The Ijaws form the majority of the Yenagoa Local Government Area.
